CREATE TABLE %PREFIX%_req_reviews ( rrv_id integer unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, rrv_uuid varchar(36) NOT NULL, rrv_org_id integer unsigned NOT NULL, rrv_user_id integer unsigned NOT NULL, rrv_requirement_type_id integer unsigned NULL, rrv_period_reference date NULL, rrv_period_to date NULL, rrv_activity_id integer unsigned NULL, rrv_kind varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'submission', rrv_reviewer_user_id integer unsigned NULL, rrv_reviewer_role_id integer unsigned NULL, rrv_status varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', rrv_due_date date NULL, rrv_message text NULL, rrv_result_comment text NULL, rrv_requested_by integer unsigned NULL, rrv_shared_at timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL, rrv_finished_by integer unsigned NULL, rrv_finished_at timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL, rrv_usr_id_create integer unsigned, rrv_timestamp_create timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, rrv_usr_id_change integer unsigned, rrv_timestamp_change timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rrv_id) ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COLLATE = utf8mb4_unicode_ci

ALTER TABLE %PREFIX%_req_reviews ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_rrv_org FOREIGN KEY (rrv_org_id) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_organizations (org_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_rrv_user FOREIGN KEY (rrv_user_id) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_users (usr_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE RESTRICT, ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_rrv_requirement FOREIGN KEY (rrv_requirement_type_id) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_req_requirement_types (rqt_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE RESTRICT, ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_rrv_activity FOREIGN KEY (rrv_activity_id) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_req_activities (rqa_id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE RESTRICT, ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_rrv_reviewer_user FOREIGN KEY (rrv_reviewer_user_id) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_users (usr_id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE RESTRICT, ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_rrv_reviewer_role FOREIGN KEY (rrv_reviewer_role_id) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_roles (rol_id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE RESTRICT, ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_rrv_requested_by FOREIGN KEY (rrv_requested_by) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_users (usr_id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE RESTRICT, ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_rrv_finished_by FOREIGN KEY (rrv_finished_by) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_users (usr_id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE RESTRICT, ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_rrv_usr_create FOREIGN KEY (rrv_usr_id_create) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_users (usr_id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE RESTRICT, ADD CONSTRAINT %PREFIX%_fk_rrv_usr_change FOREIGN KEY (rrv_usr_id_change) REFERENCES %PREFIX%_users (usr_id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE RESTRICT
